The last three queries ('promotion process...', 'on call rotation...', 'diversity equity...') are deliberately adversarial to FTS: the relevant chunk shares NO words with the query (a paraphrase) and the irrelevant chunk repeats the query's own words without answering it (keyword-stuffed) — the exact failure mode hybrid retrieval exists to catch.
